metadata.name: loot
metadata.description: Economy for Anything: one program every coin of a project passes through

accounts.name: owner
docs: The game's owner. Pays the 33 bytes of rent the record takes.

accounts.name: launcher
docs: The wallet that launched the token: the Meteora pool's creator, or the pump.fun coin's
shareholder that is not the partner. Its signature is the proof that the launcher
agrees this game is the token's game. May be the same key as `owner`.

accounts.name: venue_a
docs: Owner, discriminator, length and address are checked in `venue::judge`.

accounts.name: venue_b
docs: Checked in `venue::judge`.

instructions.name: award
docs: While a hold runs, the authority gives the held collectible to `to`.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The game's authority.

instructions.name: burn
docs: The authority destroys `amount` of what a pool holds.

instructions.name: buy_item
docs: Buy an item from the shop. Opens an order.

accounts.name: game
docs: Only read: a purchase writes nothing every other purchase of the game also writes.

accounts.name: order
docs: Any `nonce` the player has no open order at in this game.

accounts.name: vault
docs: nowhere else. Created on the first sale in that mint; that first player pays its rent.

instructions.name: buy_tickets
docs: A player buys lottery tickets.

accounts.name: mint
docs: tickets are burned (checked below; the token program checks the rest).

instructions.name: call_off
docs: Anyone calls off a contest whose result is overdue (its authority, at any time).

instructions.name: callback_lottery
docs: The oracle's answer: picks the winning ticket.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: callback_random
docs: The oracle's answer, written as a receipt.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: callback_roll
docs: The oracle's answer: picks the box order's outcome.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Anyone pays a decided contest's entry to its player.

instructions.name: close_contest
docs: Anyone closes a contest whose entries are all claimed.

instructions.name: craft
docs: A player crafts a recipe, at the version they saw, `times` over.

accounts.name: player
docs: Owns what is handed in, pays the rent of what is made and gets the rent of what is burned.

instructions.name: decide
docs: The authority names the side of a contest that won.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Put tokens into one of the game's pools.

instructions.name: draw_lottery
docs: Anyone asks the oracle for a lottery's draw once it is due.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the oracle.

accounts.name: oracle_queue
docs: whoever MagicBlock lets serve it could answer.

instructions.name: enter
docs: A player puts `amount` on one side of a contest.

instructions.name: hold
docs: A player hands a collectible to the game for `seconds`.

instructions.name: issue
docs: The authority mints tokens of a mint the game controls.

instructions.name: make
docs: The authority mints a collectible without a sale.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Pays the new asset's rent.

accounts.name: asset
docs: A new key the caller made for this asset.

instructions.name: open_box
docs: Buy a loot box and ask the oracle for its roll. Opens an order.

accounts.name: game
docs: Only read: a purchase writes nothing every other purchase of the game also writes.

accounts.name: order
docs: Any `nonce` the player has no open order at in this game.

accounts.name: vault
docs: nowhere else. Created on the first sale in that mint; that first player pays its rent.

accounts.name: oracle_queue
docs: whoever MagicBlock lets serve it could answer.

instructions.name: open_contest
docs: The authority opens a contest: sides to back, and a pot.

instructions.name: open_stake
docs: Open a stake: players lock a token and share what flows into a rewards pool.

instructions.name: pay
docs: Pay `amount`, split at once into pools, burn and the game's treasury.

accounts.name: player_token
docs: The token program checks that the player may spend it.

instructions.name: pay_lottery
docs: Anyone pays one place of a drawn lottery. The last place paid opens the next round.

accounts.name: first_place
docs: round ends, whichever place is paid last.

instructions.name: payout
docs: The authority pays `amount` from a pool to any token account.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Give an order's payment back to its player.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Pays for the player's token account if they closed it.

instructions.name: roll
docs: The authority asks the oracle for a random number, labelled `reference`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Pays the platform's fee and the oracle's.

accounts.name: oracle_queue
docs: whoever MagicBlock lets serve it could answer.

instructions.name: run_schedule
docs: Anyone runs a schedule that is due.

instructions.name: set
docs: The authority rewrites a collectible's attributes.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Pays for a longer attribute list, or gets the rent of a burned asset.

accounts.name: next_admin
docs: Who signs for the platform from now on: the current admin to keep it. It signs, so a
mistyped key can never take the platform over.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Deliver an order's item and split its payment.

accounts.name: item
docs: The item the order gives.

instructions.name: settle_prize
docs: Carry out a box order whose roll was not an item: a prize from a pool, a burn, nothing.

instructions.name: stake
docs: A player stakes, and is paid the rewards owed so far.

instructions.name: take_back
docs: Anyone sends a collectible back to its player once its hold is over.

instructions.name: unmake
docs: The authority burns a burnable collectible.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Pays for a longer attribute list, or gets the rent of a burned asset.

instructions.name: unstake
docs: A player unstakes, and is paid the rewards owed so far. Zero only collects rewards.
`forfeit` gives up the rewards owed instead, for when they cannot be paid.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Gets back the rent of an official token's record once the token was cleared.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: account of the game's mint (checked below).

accounts.name: new_owner
docs: The owner from now on, when it changes. It signs, so a mistyped key can never take the
game over.

instructions.name: upsert_lottery
docs: Write a lottery: tickets into a pot, a draw on a timer.

instructions.name: upsert_recipe
docs: Write a recipe: collectibles and tokens in, collectibles and tokens out.

instructions.name: upsert_schedule
docs: Write a schedule: mint, burn or move on a timer.

errors.name: NotTheGames
errors.msg: Signer is not the game's owner or its authority

errors.name: NotAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the game's authority

errors.name: NotPlatform
errors.msg: Signer is not the platform admin or the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: BadCollection
errors.msg: Collection is not a Core collection this signer controls

errors.name: CollectionCanSeize

errors.name: FeeAboveCap

errors.name: StringTooLong

errors.name: BadShares

errors.name: SupplyBelowIssued

errors.name: PoolNotEmpty

errors.name: KindLocked

errors.name: Paused

errors.name: Suspended

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: NotForSale

errors.name: SoldOut

errors.name: PriceAboveMax
errors.msg: The price is above the most the buyer agreed to pay

errors.name: WrongPool
errors.msg: A share names an account that was not passed, or the wrong account was

errors.name: NotTheHolders
errors.msg: A share for whoever holds a collectible must go to a token account of that mint that the holder owns

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: This is not the mint the price is in

errors.name: BadOrderState
errors.msg: Order is not in the right state

errors.name: NotStale
errors.msg: Order is not stale yet

errors.name: ItemMismatch
errors.msg: Item or pool accounts don't match the box or the order

errors.name: WrongSettle
errors.msg: This order's outcome is settled by the other settle instruction

errors.name: NotThePlayers
errors.msg: The prize must go to a token account the order's player owns

errors.name: NotCollectible
errors.msg: Only a collectible item can be made as an asset

errors.name: BadSchedule
errors.msg: A schedule needs a period above zero, a share of 100% or less, and a move between two different pools

errors.name: NotDue
errors.msg: This is not due yet

errors.name: ScheduleOver
errors.msg: This schedule is switched off or has done its last run

errors.name: BadLottery
errors.msg: A lottery needs a price and a period above zero, a period of at most 1,000 years and a first draw between 1970 and 1,000 years later, a cut of 100% or less, and at most 8 places that each take something and together 100% or less

errors.name: RoundRunning
errors.msg: A lottery can't be changed while tickets of its round are sold

errors.name: SalesClosed
errors.msg: Ticket sales are closed for this round

errors.name: StillLocked

errors.name: MoreThanStaked

errors.name: BadRecipe

errors.name: OnceAtATime

errors.name: NeedNotMet

errors.name: RecipeChanged

errors.name: NotReady

errors.name: Expired

errors.name: UsedUp

errors.name: Held

errors.name: TermsChanged

errors.name: ResultOverdue

errors.name: StillHeld

errors.name: HoldOver

errors.name: BadContest

errors.name: VenueLayout

errors.name: LauncherMustSign

types.name: Action
docs: What a schedule does each time it runs.

types.name: Attribute
docs: One line on a collectible: "level" = "7".

types.name: AttributesSet
docs: The game's authority rewrote a collectible's attributes. The new values are the
instruction's own arguments, in the same transaction.

types.name: Awarded
docs: The authority gave a held collectible to `to`, while its hold ran.

types.name: Burned
docs: The game's authority burned tokens out of a pool.

types.name: CalledOff
docs: A contest was called off: every entry gets its own money back.

types.name: Claimed
docs: An entry was paid `amount` and closed.

types.name: Contest
docs: At `["contest", game, id]`. Its pot is the token account at `["pot", contest]`.

fields.name: opener
docs: The authority that opened it. Paid its rent, and gets it back when it closes.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token it is played in.

fields.name: closes_at
docs: Unix time entries stop.

fields.name: result_by
docs: Unix time a result is due. After it, no result is taken and anyone can call the contest off.

fields.name: terms
docs: A hash of what an entry agrees to (`terms`). A player signs it, so an entry never lands
in another contest opened at the same id.

fields.name: winner
docs: The side that won, once the verdict is `Won`.

fields.name: entries
docs: Entries not yet claimed.

fields.name: prize
docs: What the winning side shares, set when the result is named.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: What the winning side put in and has not yet claimed for.

fields.name: shares
docs: The parts of the pot taken when the result is named.

fields.name: sides
docs: What each side has put in.

fields.name: sides
docs: How many sides there are to back.

types.name: Crafted
docs: A player crafted a recipe. The tokens it took and gave are the recipe's own lines.

fields.name: version
docs: The recipe's version: its lines, as they were, say what tokens moved.

fields.name: times
docs: How many times over: every token line moved its amount times this.

fields.name: burned
docs: The collectibles burned, used and kept, and made.

types.name: Decided
docs: The authority named the side that won. `prize` is what its backers share.

types.name: Deposited
docs: Someone funded a pool.

fields.name: amount
docs: What arrived in the pool: what was sent, less any transfer fee.

fields.name: weight
docs: The chance of this entry is its weight over the sum of the weights still in stock (each
first scaled by what is left of its item, when the box says `stock_odds`).

types.name: Entered
docs: A player put `amount` on one side of a contest.

types.name: Entry
docs: At `["entry", contest, player, side]`: what one player put on one side. They pay its rent
and get it back when it is claimed.

types.name: Fall
docs: A price that falls with time: a drop whose price comes down until it sells, a seat that
cools off between buyers. It falls by `step` every `every` seconds counted from `since`,
and never below `floor` (a price already below the floor stays where it is).
The owner sets `since`: the price holds until then. Each sale after it sets it to the time
of the sale, so the price starts falling again from what was paid, after any `Rise`. A price that
falls to 0 is no longer for sale.

fields.name: fees
docs: The fees in force now, in lamports.

fields.name: pending
docs: A raise waiting out its notice period, and when it applies (0: none).

types.name: Fees
docs: The platform's two flat fees, in lamports. A player's few transactions carry the larger
one; a project's many (an airdrop to ten thousand players) carry the smaller.

fields.name: player
docs: What a player pays when they sign for something of their own: a payment, a purchase,
a craft, tickets, a stake or an unstake, a hold, an entry.

fields.name: project
docs: What every other charged instruction costs: a deposit, a payout, a burn, an issue, a
make, a roll, an award, a contest opened or decided.

types.name: Game
docs: One per project, at `["game", collection]`. It is also the signer the program uses for the
project: it owns the pools and the order vault, mints the project's tokens and collectibles.
Only `create_game` creates one, at that address, so an account this program owns with this
tag is a game at its own address: instructions check the owner and the tag (Anchor's
`Account`) and do not derive the address again. Signing still uses the stored `bump`.

fields.name: owner
docs: Signs the settings, the catalog and every mechanic. Can hand the game to another key.
A project has two keys, this one and `authority`, and both are trusted.

fields.name: authority
docs: Signs what leaves a pool, what gets made and what only the game knows (`payout`, `burn`,
`issue`, `make`, `unmake`, `set`, `roll`, `award`, `open_contest`, `decide`). A wallet, a multisig, a server's key or another program's address. The program
checks this signature and nothing else. It pays the flat fee in SOL, so it must be a
plain address that holds some.

fields.name: collection
docs: The Metaplex Core collection the game's collectibles are minted into.

fields.name: mint
docs: The currency of the shop: every item's price is in this mint, and a box's unless it
names another.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Token account that receives whatever a split leaves over.

fields.name: fees_bump
docs: The bump of the game's fee box, `["fees", game]`.

fields.name: paused
docs: The owner's switch: stops what comes in (`pay`, `buy_item`, `open_box`, `craft`,
`buy_tickets`, `stake`, `hold`, `enter`).

fields.name: suspended
docs: The platform's switch: stops the same. Never what is owed (settle, refund, payout,
unstake, a lottery's draw and payment, a held collectible going home, a contest's claim).

fields.name: official
docs: The game's official token: one launched with games.fun that pays its share. Written only
by `attach_token`, a record and not a gate: no economy instruction reads it.

types.name: GameUpdate
docs: What to change. `None` leaves a setting as it is.

types.name: Held
docs: A player handed a collectible to the game until `free_at`.

types.name: Hold
docs: At `["hold", asset]`. The player pays its rent and gets it back when the hold ends.

fields.name: player
docs: Who handed it in, and who it goes back to.

fields.name: free_at
docs: Unix time the authority's say ends.

fields.name: reference
docs: The game's own label: the raid, the borrower.

types.name: Input
docs: One thing a recipe takes.

types.name: Issued
docs: The game's authority minted tokens of a mint the game controls.

types.name: Item
docs: Something the game sells, drops from a box, or makes. The fixed fields come first so a box
roll can read them at fixed places (`ItemView`).

fields.name: soulbound
docs: Collectibles only: frozen for good at mint, so it can't be transferred.

fields.name: burnable
docs: Collectibles only: the game's authority can burn it later (`unmake`).

fields.name: max_supply
docs: 0 means unlimited.

fields.name: issued
docs: Handed out so far, by sales, boxes and `make`. Also the last serial number used.

fields.name: voided
docs: Serials of refunded orders that could not be taken back (`ItemView::release`). They stay
gaps in the numbering, and the units they stood for can be sold again under new numbers.
So once a serial is voided, a later one can be above `max_supply`: a serial is a number,
not a count. The count of units out is `issued - voided`, and it never passes the supply.

fields.name: price
docs: Shop price in the game's mint. 0 means it is not sold directly.

fields.name: active
docs: Switched off, it is not sold, dropped from a box or made by a recipe. The authority's
own `make` still works.

fields.name: rise
docs: Makes the shop price rise with every sale.

fields.name: fall
docs: Makes the shop price fall with time.

fields.name: life
docs: Collectibles only: when a recipe can take one, and how often.

fields.name: shares
docs: Where a shop sale of this item sends its money.

types.name: Keep
docs: An attribute a new collectible takes from one handed in.

fields.name: from
docs: Which collectible handed in it comes from, and which collectible made it goes to: the
first of each is 0.

types.name: Life
docs: How a collectible lives, for the recipes that take it (`craft.rs`). Every time is in
seconds, and 0 switches that rule off.

fields.name: ready_after
docs: It can't go into a recipe until this long after it was made: an egg that incubates, a
crop that grows.

fields.name: lasts
docs: It can't go into a recipe once this long has passed since it was made: food that rots,
a pet that dies.

fields.name: uses
docs: The times a recipe can use it without burning it: a breed count, a tool that wears out,
a mine that runs dry.

fields.name: cooldown
docs: The wait between two uses: a cooldown, a daily turn.

types.name: LootBox
docs: A loot box: a price and a drop table. The odds on a page are these bytes.

fields.name: currency
docs: The mint the price is in. `None` is the game's own. A box in another mint has shares
that take the whole payment, because the treasury only holds the game's mint.

fields.name: rise
docs: Makes the price rise with every box opened.

fields.name: fall
docs: Makes the price fall with time.

fields.name: stock_odds
docs: Each item's weight shrinks with its stock: it is multiplied by the share of the item's
supply still left, rounded up. The last mythic of 100 is a hundred times rarer than the
first. Items with no supply limit and the other outcomes keep their weight.

fields.name: opened
docs: Times opened.

fields.name: version
docs: Counts its edits. An order remembers the version it paid for, and is not rolled on any
other: it fails and refunds.

fields.name: shares
docs: Where a sale of this box sends its money.

types.name: Lottery
docs: At `["lottery", game, id]`. The list of purchases follows these fields in the same account.

fields.name: price
docs: The price of one ticket, in the mint of the pot (or in `ticket_mint`).

fields.name: pot
docs: The pool that holds the pot.

fields.name: cut_bps
docs: The share of ticket money that goes to the game's treasury instead of the pot.

fields.name: places
docs: What each place wins, in basis points of the pot: first place first. Unused places are 0.

fields.name: ticket_mint
docs: When set, a ticket costs `price` of this mint and is burned, and no ticket money
reaches the pot. The default address means there is none: tickets pay into the pot.

fields.name: every
docs: Seconds from one draw to the next.

fields.name: draws_at
docs: Unix time this round's draw is due. Sales stop then.

fields.name: round
docs: Counts up by one each time a winner is paid.

fields.name: sold
docs: Tickets sold this round. They are numbered from 0.

fields.name: asked_slot
docs: The slot the draw was asked in.

fields.name: winner
docs: Who holds first place, once drawn.

fields.name: first_ticket
docs: The ticket that won first place.

fields.name: paid
docs: The places paid this round, one bit each.

fields.name: pot_at_payout
docs: What the pot held when the first place of this round was paid. The shares are of this.

fields.name: places
docs: What each place wins, in basis points of the pot, first place first. Empty means one
winner who takes all.

types.name: LotteryDrawn
docs: A lottery's round was drawn.

fields.name: winning_ticket
docs: First place's ticket. The others follow at even steps (`Lottery::ticket_of_place`).

fields.name: winners
docs: Each place's winner, first place first.

types.name: LotteryPaid
docs: One place of a lottery was paid its share of the pot.

types.name: Made
docs: The game's authority minted a collectible without a sale.

types.name: Need
docs: A number a recipe asks of a collectible handed in: the game's authority wrote `key` on it
(`set`), and it must be `at_least` this much.

fields.name: place
docs: Which collectible: the first handed in is 0, in the recipe's order.

types.name: Order
docs: One purchase from the shop or a box, held until it is settled or refunded. The player pays
its rent and gets it back either way.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint the player paid in.

fields.name: loot_box
docs: The box opened and its version then, or the default key for a shop purchase.

fields.name: outcome
docs: What the order gives, once it is rolled.

fields.name: serial
docs: The item's serial number, for an item.

fields.name: paid
docs: What the player paid, held in the game's vault until settle or refund.

fields.name: fee
docs: The platform's fee and the split, fixed at purchase so later edits don't touch a paid
order. The fee waits in the escrow.

fields.name: requested_slot
docs: The slot of the purchase. Refund deadlines count from it.

types.name: OrderFailed
docs: A box order could not be rolled: nothing in it could be won, or the box was edited after
the purchase. The order can be refunded.

types.name: OrderRefunded
docs: An order's payment went back to its player.

fields.name: serial_released
docs: Whether the order's serial number went back to its item.

types.name: OrderRolled
docs: An order has its outcome: an item bought from the shop, or whatever a box rolled.

fields.name: loot_box
docs: The box, or the default key for a shop purchase.

fields.name: serial
docs: The item's serial number, for an item.

fields.name: randomness
docs: The oracle's random bytes the item was picked with. Zeros for a shop purchase.

types.name: OrderSettled
docs: An order was delivered and its payment split.

fields.name: outcome
docs: What the player got.

fields.name: asset
docs: The minted collectible, or the default key when nothing was minted.

fields.name: amount
docs: What the player paid.

fields.name: burned
docs: How much of it was burned because the outcome was `Burn`. Then nothing was split.

types.name: Origin
docs: Where tokens a recipe gives come from.

types.name: Outcome
docs: What a box can give.

types.name: Output
docs: One thing a recipe gives.

types.name: Paid
docs: A player paid, and the payment was split at once.

fields.name: amount
docs: What the player sent, the amount they signed. A mint with a transfer fee takes its fee
out of each part on the way, so each place gets its part less that fee.

fields.name: shares
docs: Where the shares went. Each was sent `amount * bps / 10,000`, rounded down.

fields.name: to_treasury
docs: What was sent to the treasury.

types.name: PaidOut
docs: The game's authority paid from a pool.

fields.name: to
docs: The token account that received it.

types.name: Platform
docs: One for the whole program, at `["platform"]`: our fees. Only `init_platform` creates one, at
that address, so an account this program owns with this tag is the platform: instructions
check the owner and the tag (Anchor's `Account`) and do not derive the address again.
The fees themselves collect in each game's fee box (`FEES_SEED`) until the admin takes them
out, so this account is only ever read by a game's transactions and never holds them up.

fields.name: partner
docs: The launch partner an official token pays at its venue (the registry, `venue.rs`).
Set once: venue accounts that name it can never change.

fields.name: fees
docs: The fees in force.

fields.name: pending
docs: A raise waiting out its notice period. Meaningless while `pending_at` is 0.

fields.name: pending_at
docs: Unix time the pending fees apply from. 0 means there are none.

types.name: Recipe
docs: At `["recipe", game, id]`.

fields.name: version
docs: Counts its edits. A player signs the version they saw, and crafts no other.

types.name: Returned
docs: A held collectible went back to its player.

types.name: Rise
docs: A price that rises with every sale: a bonding curve, a throne that costs 10% more each time.
After a sale the price becomes `price + step + price * growth_bps / 10,000`.

types.name: Rolled
docs: The oracle answered a `roll`. What the number decides is the game's own rule.

fields.name: reference
docs: The label the authority gave the request.

types.name: Schedule
docs: At `["schedule", game, id]`.

fields.name: every
docs: Seconds between runs.

fields.name: next_at
docs: Unix time of the next run.

fields.name: runs
docs: Runs so far.

fields.name: max_runs
docs: Stops after this many runs. 0: never stops.

types.name: ScheduleRan
docs: A schedule ran: it minted, burned or moved `amount`.

fields.name: run
docs: Which run this was, counted from 1.

types.name: Share
docs: A part of a payment, in basis points of the whole (10,000 = 100%).

types.name: Stake
docs: At `["stake", game, id]`.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token players stake.

fields.name: rewards_pool
docs: The pool rewards arrive in, and the mint it had when the stake was opened.

fields.name: lock
docs: Seconds a position must wait, after its last stake, before any of it can be taken out.

fields.name: total
docs: Staked by everyone, right now.

fields.name: reward_per_token
docs: Rewards credited so far for each staked token, times `PRECISION`.

types.name: Staked
docs: A player staked `amount` more and was paid `rewards`. `staked` is their position now.

types.name: TicketsBought
docs: A player bought lottery tickets `first_ticket .. first_ticket + count`.

types.name: To
docs: Where a share of a payment goes.

fields.name: reason
docs: The `LootError` code of the rule that no longer holds.

types.name: Unmade
docs: The game's authority burned a collectible.

types.name: Unstaked
docs: A player took `amount` out of their stake and was paid `rewards`.

types.name: Venue
docs: Where an official token was launched.

constants.name: ASSET_SEED
docs: `["asset", order, slot of the purchase]`: the collectible an order mints. The slot keeps a
later order that reuses the same nonce from landing on an address already taken: an order
never closes in the slot it was opened in (`settle.rs`).

constants.name: BOX_SEED
docs: `["box", game, box id]`

constants.name: CONTEST_SEED
docs: `["contest", game, id]`, its pot at `["pot", contest]`, and one player's stake on one side
at `["entry", contest, player, side]`.

constants.name: ESCROW_LAMPORTS
docs: Put in the escrow on every purchase. A Core asset with our plugins costs about 0.004 SOL.

constants.name: ESCROW_SEED
docs: `["escrow", order]`: holds the SOL an order needs (the collectible's rent and the fee), so
anyone can settle without the player signing twice. What is left goes back to the player.

constants.name: FEES_SEED
docs: `["fees", game]`: the game's fee box, an account of this program that holds nothing but
SOL. The platform's fees on that game's transactions wait there until it collects them, so
one game's traffic never queues behind another's on a shared account.

constants.name: GAME_SEED
docs: `["game", collection]`

constants.name: HOLD_SEED
docs: `["hold", asset]`: a collectible the game is holding for a player.

constants.name: ITEM_SEED
docs: `["item", game, item id]`

constants.name: MAX_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: The most either flat fee can ever be: 0.01 SOL.

constants.name: NOTICE_SECONDS
docs: A fee raise waits this long before it applies (7 days). A cut applies at once.

constants.name: ORDER_SEED
docs: `["order", game, player, nonce]`

constants.name: PLAYER_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: The fees the platform starts with: 0.002 SOL when a player signs for something of their own,
0.00001 SOL for everything else, so a project paying out to ten thousand players pays 0.1 SOL
in fees, not 20.

constants.name: POOL_SEED
docs: `["pool", game, index]`: a token account the game owns.

constants.name: POSITION_SEED
docs: `["position", stake, player]`: one player's stake.

constants.name: ROLLED_REFUND_SLOTS
docs: An order that is rolled and still not settled after this many slots (7 days at 400 ms a slot,
counted from the purchase) can be refunded. It is the deadline a game has to settle, and the
way out when a settle cannot succeed.

constants.name: SCHEDULE_SEED
docs: `["schedule", game, id]`, `["lottery", game, id]`,
`["stake", game, id]`, `["recipe", game, id]`: the mechanics a game runs without its
authority.

constants.name: STAKED_SEED
docs: `["staked", stake]` and `["rewards", stake]`: the two vaults of a stake.

constants.name: STALE_SLOTS
docs: A box still waiting for its roll after this many slots (about 10 minutes) can be refunded.
